comparison: The same executable Euclid algorithm, fr, shared skills, declarations, plan nodes and dependencies. Compare checklist and graph rendering only; no automatic search controller.
publication: User approved patches and summary only. Full logs, prompts, exports, source archives and execution packets stay local.
accounting: CLI-reported categories retain client meanings. Unknown account charges and incomplete usage are not replaced with zero.
cache_state: Fresh conversations and projects, with a separate new .fr/cache for each attempt. Operating-system and provider caches are uncontrolled.
resource_scope: Independent sampled limits cover the guard, controller, native CLI and workers, including preparation and accounting. The observer stays outside the CPU throttle. Short peaks and children reparented before discovery can still be missed.

controls.program: The actual executable Lean Algorithm.euclid, for every pair of Nat inputs.

euclid.protected_source:
prelude
import Init.Data.Nat.Gcd

namespace Algorithm

theorem euclid_decreases (a b : Nat) (hb : b ≠ 0) : a % b < b := by
  -- fr:proof-begin euclid_decreases
<proof euclid_decreases>
  -- fr:proof-end euclid_decreases

def euclid (a b : Nat) : Nat :=
  if b = 0 then a else euclid b (a % b)
termination_by b
decreasing_by
  apply euclid_decreases
  assumption

theorem euclid_correct (a b : Nat) : euclid a b = Nat.gcd a b := by
  -- fr:proof-begin euclid_correct
<proof euclid_correct>
  -- fr:proof-end euclid_correct

end Algorithm
